description: This file defines a templated SocketServerType class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It manages socket connections, including accepting new clients, handling client communication, and maintaining client lists through nested classes such as IteratorType and SocketHandler. The file includes methods for opening, closing, suspending clients, and submitting data packages to clients. It also manages thread safety with locking mechanisms and handles socket events via inheritance from SocketListner.

classes.name: SocketServerType
classes.description: A templated class managing socket server operations, client connections, and message handling within the WPEFramework::Core namespace.

classes.name: IteratorType
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing connected clients managed by SocketServerType.

classes.name: SocketHandler
classes.description: A nested class within SocketServerType that handles socket listening, accepting new clients, and client management with thread safety.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the socket server to start listening for incoming connections.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket server and all active client connections.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Removes closed or suspended clients from the internal list.

methods.name: Client
methods.description: Retrieves a proxy to a client by its ID.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends a client connection by its ID.

methods.name: LocalNode
methods.description: Sets the local node information for socket communication.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a data package to a client identified by ID.

methods.name: Clients
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the current clients.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of active clients.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the internal data structures for thread safety.
